title: Keyring
description: A complete "no passwords saved" state in isometric line, facing the screen: a key ring hanging from a small wall hook whose keys swing on the ring when it's jostled, then hang still, over a heading, a line of copy and a button you set through props. One even outline, no shadow; the tag carries your brand. Plays when it comes into view or each time `active` turns true; in your theme.
